description: This file defines the DefaultAdaptorFactory class, implementing the ILogViewAdaptorFactory interface, responsible for creating log view adaptors with storage capabilities within Orleans event sourcing.

classes.name: DefaultAdaptorFactory
classes.description: Implements ILogViewAdaptorFactory to produce log view adaptors for Orleans event sourcing.

methods.name: UsesStorageProvider
methods.description: Indicates whether this factory uses a storage provider, always returning true.
